needs.reason: Versions are literal. The classes Greeter.java imports (HelloRequest, HelloReply) exist only after generateProto writes them into build/generated/source/proto/main/java: a static index of the fixture finds no declaration for them.

traps: src/generated/java/com/example/greeting/v1/GreetingProto.java is protoc output checked in by hand: its first line is the protoc header that Linguist uses to mark it generated. It is in no source set, and it is a stale partial copy (only the outer class of the five files protoc writes for greeting.proto).
A reader that infers source sets from src/<name>/java takes src/generated as a source set named generated; Gradle does not.
The code that Greeter.java compiles against is regenerated at every build into build/generated/source/proto/main/java (plugin 0.9.4 layout: source, not sources), which does not exist in the fixture.
The protobuf plugin adds src/main/proto to the main source set: the .proto file is a build input, Protocol Buffer for Linguist.
protoc 4.28.3 is a Maven artifact the plugin downloads for the platform, so it is a build dependency, not a toolchain to install.
The checked-in header reads NO CHECKED-IN PROTOBUF GENCODE: protoc 4.x writes it in every Java file, a hint that this copy should not be in the repository.
